units.source_text: 启封白88，大竹七段下了黑89，是十时四十八分。

en.t: White 88 was unsealed, and when Otake seventh-dan played Black 89, it was 10:48.

units.source_text: 这样，名人下白90已过晌午，快一点半还没决定下来。

en.t: Thus, the Meijin had still not decided on White 90 after noon, even as it neared 1:30.

units.source_text: 他强忍病痛，整整思考了两小时零七分。

en.t: Holding back his illness and pain, he thought for a full two hours and seven minutes.

units.source_text: 这期间，名人始终正襟危坐。

en.t: During that time, the Meijin sat upright and formal from beginning to end.

units.source_text: 脸上的浮肿反而消退了些许。

en.t: The swelling in his face had, if anything, gone down a little.
At that point, it was finally decided to take the lunch break.
